t: Any word or term used in any title of this Act, unless the context requires otherwise, shall have the same meaning as that applicable to such word or term in the Act to which such title applies.

fable.w: This is a purely definitional/interpretive provision stating that terms carry the meaning they have in the underlying Act. There is no tempting reading here: it involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision.
fable.s: Any word or term used in any title of this Act, unless the context requires otherwise, shall have the same meaning as that applicable to such word or term in the Act to which such title applies.

qwen_block.s: Any word or term used in any title of this Act, unless the context requires otherwise, shall have the same meaning as that applicable to such word or term in the Act to which such title applies.

opus.w: This is a definitions rule: words in each title take the meaning they have in the Act that title amends. It sets up no consultation, comment period, hearing, advisory body, rulemaking authority or right to sue. No outside party takes part in any federal decision, so it is not participation.
opus.b: I see no tempting "Yes" reading here. This is a definitions rule saying that terms carry the meaning used in the underlying Act. It mentions no consultation, hearing, advisory body, rulemaking or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government is involved in any decision.

qwen_chat.w: This section is a standard definitions clause that establishes how terms should be interpreted by referencing other statutes. It does not create any advisory bodies, public comment periods, consultations with outside entities, or rights to sue. It is purely interpretive and procedural within the legal framework, involving no interaction with parties outside the federal government.
qwen_chat.s: Any word or term used in any title of this Act, unless the context requires otherwise, shall have the same meaning as that applicable to such word or term in the Act to which such title applies.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that because this section references other Acts, and those other Acts might contain participation requirements, this section implicitly requires participation. However, this section itself is merely a rule of construction defining terms; it does not establish any process, committee, hearing, or consultation mechanism. It contains no actors outside the government and no procedural steps for decision-making.
